_comment: Single source of truth for the progress bar in README.md / README.zh-HK.md. Run `python scripts/progress.py` to recompute and rewrite the marked blocks; `python scripts/progress.py --check` fails if the READMEs are stale. A task earns its weight only at its evidence level: offline = 50%, real NinjaTrader Sim/Demo = 100%. Nothing here is prop-firm or live acceptance. Weights are the maintainer's judgement of how much each item matters for 'safe to copy to Demo / prop-firm Sim accounts', not a measured quantity.

snapshot.note: Levels were assigned by the maintainer's agent from the evidence listed per item and then deliberately lowered where a step was not re-run on the current build. Read the evidence column, not just the bar.

3.label: offline PLUS verified on real NinjaTrader Simulator / prop-firm Sim accounts (SIM TEST build)

demo.ready_when: every item with must=true is at level 3, and there is no open P0 safety defect

prop.name_zh: 複製到 Prop Firm 帳戶（評估／funded）
prop.ready_when: demo target ready, plus prop-only items at level 3, plus a rule review per firm by the user (never certified by this software)

items.en: Leader to followers: entry, exit, cancel, modify; short and long
items.zh: Leader 跟單：入場、平倉、取消、改單；做多做空
items.evidence: Real NT on the current build (2026-10-13): Buy/Sell market round trips, a passive Limit copied and its cancel mirrored, exit copied to the follower that was not flattened. Only two follower accounts, only Limit and Market orders, MNQ only. StopMarket entries and a real multi-lot partial fill were not seen.
items.ach_en: Core copy: entry / exit / cancel / modify
items.ach_zh: 核心跟單：入場／平倉／取消／改單

items.en: Per-account Ratio and max-lot cap, over-cap entry skipped
items.zh: 每戶 Ratio 同最大手數，超過上限唔落單
items.evidence: Real NT: Buy 2 above a 1-lot cap sent nothing to either follower. Ratio 1 only on real NT; fractional ratios are offline.
items.ach_zh: 每戶 Ratio ＋ 最大手數

items.en: Leader exit with nothing to close does not lock a flat follower
items.zh: Leader 平倉但 follower 冇倉，唔會鎖死
items.evidence: Reproduced offline (needs 2 prior round trips), fixed, replayed on real NT.
items.ach_en: No lock-up on a flat follower

items.en: Per-account Flat button (one account only, confirmation, never retried)
items.zh: 每帳戶獨立 Flat 按鈕（只平一戶、要確認、唔重試）
items.evidence: Real NT (2 sessions): Flat on one follower; the other kept copying; that account's working orders cancelled. Also with a stop and target (same OCO id) still working: both cancelled, account closed, other follower unaffected. A Flat the provider rejects and a disconnect during Flat are not tested on real NT.
items.ach_zh: 每個帳戶獨立 Flat 按鈕

items.en: Flatten selected / all, with confirmation naming accounts
items.zh: 批量／全部 Flatten，確認框列出帳戶
items.evidence: Offline Flatten cases (selected / all / subset / thrown / dry-run). On real NT only the per-account Flat was exercised on purpose; Flatten-all was used for cleanup, its behaviour was not checked step by step. Demoted from real-NT tested.

items.en: ATM / TP-SL exit mirroring with OCO between legs
items.zh: ATM／TP-SL 出場跟隨，兩邊 OCO
items.evidence: Real NT: leader Stop + Limit under one OCO id copied to both followers (Working), per-account Flat cancels them, and a leader MARKET exit closes the follower and cancels both once (after the market-exit fix). NOT covered on real NT: modify of price/quantity this session, a rejected stop, fractional multi-group OCO (#3), and a stop + target WITHOUT an OCO id (locks the account, open).

items.en: Fail-closed locks (unknown exposure, thrown Flatten, rejected stop), no auto-retry, explicit unlock
items.zh: 異常即鎖帳戶（未知倉位、Flatten 失敗、保護單被拒）、唔自動重試、要人手解鎖
items.evidence: Many offline cases + mutants; unlock prompt used on real NT. Real provider rejections not exercised.
items.ach_zh: 異常自動鎖帳戶、唔自動重試

items.en: Disconnect / reconnect: lock, no catch-up, protection kept
items.zh: 斷線／重連：鎖定、唔補單、保護單保留
items.evidence: 8 offline cases (fake provider). Real disconnect never exercised.

items.en: Partial fills: exit sized to filled lots, shortfall never made up
items.zh: 部分成交：平倉按已成交手數、唔補差額
items.evidence: Offline cases + mutant. Real partial fills not observed (sim fills whole).

items.en: Coherent fill frontier before protective resize (#2)
items.zh: 保護單改量前成交一致性 (#2)
items.evidence: Quantity freeze + 150-combination sweep offline; full design open.

items.en: One stalled follower cannot freeze the others; clean Dispose (#4)
items.zh: 一戶卡住唔影響其他；安全關閉 (#4)
items.evidence: Per-account dispatcher offline (10/20/30 fake). Real call timing unmeasured.
items.ach_en: One stuck account never freezes others (#4)

items.en: 10-30 accounts on real NinjaTrader (latency, UI)
items.zh: 真 NT 跑 10-30 個帳戶（延遲、介面）
items.evidence: Only 2 real sim accounts tested. 30 synthetic rows in the UI test.
items.ach_zh: 真 NT 跑 10-30 個帳戶

items.en: Dashboard: dense table, per-row Tgt/DLL/Ratio/ATM/OFF/Flat, bulk edit, lock reasons, logs
items.zh: 介面：緊湊表格、每行設定、批量改、鎖定原因、Log
items.evidence: 45 offline UI cases; used on real NT. Real DPI / IME / paste untested (#8).
items.ach_zh: 介面（表格、批量改、鎖定原因）

items.en: Per-account daily target and daily loss limit with one-click OFF
items.zh: 每戶每日目標／虧損上限、一鍵 OFF
items.evidence: Offline latch cases. The limit was never actually hit on a real account.
items.ach_en: Daily target / loss limit per account
items.ach_zh: 每戶每日目標／虧損上限

items.en: Journal and verified restart recovery (#6) - shelved
items.zh: Journal 同重啟恢復 (#6)：擱置
items.evidence: Latches persist across restart (seen on real NT). Position/ledger recovery not built.

items.en: Reaction to divergence: flatten once (#12)
items.zh: 反向時平倉一次 (#12)
items.evidence: Setting stored only; engine never flattens by itself.

items.en: Adopt an existing follower position (#11)
items.zh: 承接 follower 現有倉位 (#11)
items.evidence: Not built.

items.en: Self-managed TP/SL per account (#10)
items.zh: 每戶自管 TP/SL (#10)
items.evidence: Not started.

items.en: Installer / compiled release, release hold lifted by a reviewed decision
items.zh: 安裝包／編譯版本、經覆核解除交易封鎖
items.evidence: Only a SIM TEST build with an operator allow-list exists; default build is still held; no installer.
items.ach_zh: 安裝包 ＋ 覆核後發佈

items.en: Prop-firm rule compliance (per firm, per phase)
items.zh: 各 Prop Firm 規則合規
items.evidence: Deliberately out of scope: the software never certifies compliance; the user must read each firm's rules.
items.ach_zh: Prop Firm 規則檢查（本軟件唔保證）
